coach.title: Practice Coach
coach.betaHint: Experimental — behaviour may change between builds
coach.brainHint: An AI model on this computer writes the coach's tips and reports. Off keeps short written tips.
coach.brainOffHint: No AI coaching — timing feedback only
coach.brainStandardHint: Qwen3 4B. ~2.5 GB download, ~4 GB RAM while running. The floor — runs on CPU if you have no GPU.
coach.brainStudioHint: Qwen3 8B. ~5 GB download, ~8 GB RAM. Richer feedback and practice plans; needs 16 GB of RAM.
coach.brainStudioNeedsRam: Studio needs at least 16 GB of RAM — this machine has less.
coach.brainUpdateHint: Your downloaded model is from an older generation. Updating replaces it with Qwen3.
coach.brainStandardNeedsRam: Standard needs at least 8 GB of RAM — this machine has less.
coach.statusTemplateBuild: Written tips only — this build can't run a model
coach.statusNoModel: No model downloaded — the coach uses short written tips
coach.statusReadyNotLoaded: Coach model ready — it loads when you start practising
coach.statusLegacyWeights: The downloaded model is from an older generation and won't be loaded — update it below
coach.statusWarmingUp: Loading the coach model — written tips until it's ready
coach.tiersAllModel: Tips, reports and chat all use the AI
coach.tiersTipsTemplate: Tips: instant templates · Reports and chat: AI
coach.tiersTipsTemplateMeasured: Tips: instant templates · Reports and chat: AI ({{seconds}}s each)
coach.scoringModeHint: How the coach grades your timing in the tools. Sessions always grade the same way.
coach.scoringDefaultDesc: Grades on feel and groove — the right mode for most players. Rewards locking into the pulse, not subdivision-by-subdivision precision.
coach.scoringProDesc: Every subdivision graded against the beat grid. Designed for players drilling tight accuracy — significantly more demanding.
coach.voiceSilentHint: No audio — feedback appears as text only
coach.voiceSpeakHint: Spoken feedback using local text-to-speech after each session segment
coach.verbosityLessHint: Coach only speaks urgent events; calm nudges stay written-only
coach.verbosityDefaultHint: Coach speaks only when the gatekeeper picks the spoken tier
coach.verbosityMoreHint: Coach also speaks written-tier nudges (more talkative)
coach.voiceNameBrainOffHint: Choose Standard or Studio above to pick a voice
coach.voiceNameSilentHint: Switch Voice on to choose a personality
coach.voiceCorrupted: {{name}} — voice file is corrupted (click Repair below)
coach.voicesEngineMissing: Speech engine is missing — voices can't speak until it's reinstalled.
coach.voicesCorrupted: One or more voice files look corrupted. Re-download to fix.
coach.voicesNotInstalled: Voices aren't installed yet — download to enable spoken coaching.
coach.stanceHint: How hard the coach is on you while you play in the tools
coach.stanceStrictDesc: Names a lean the moment it shows, and says it out loud. The right setting when you are drilling a passage you already know.
coach.stanceLearningDesc: Gives you half again as much room before it says anything, keeps corrections out of your ears while you play, and leads with what went right. Your score is worked out exactly the same either way.
coach.cuesNoVoice: Needs a coach voice: choose Standard or Studio above. Until then the cues stay on screen.
coach.toolsOnlyHint: Applies in the Metronome, Drill and Jam. Sessions always grade the same way.

hotkeys.testTitle: Test all input bindings (keyboard, MIDI, gamepad)
hotkeys.keyTooltip: Works only when the app is focused
hotkeys.globalTooltip: Works even when the app is in the background

hotkeys.listening: Listening… press a MIDI button or foot pedal

descs.sig-next: Cycle to next time signature — adds a beat in FREE mode
descs.sig-prev: Cycle to previous time signature — removes a beat in FREE mode
descs.toggle-sidebar: Collapse or expand the left sidebar
descs.toggle-coach: Open or close the practice coach panel
descs.jam-next-groove: Step to the next groove without taking a hand off the instrument
descs.jam-prev-groove: Step back to the previous groove
descs.jam-trade: Turn trading on or off — the band plays four bars, you play four
descs.jam-dropout: Turn the drop-out bars on or off
descs.jam-next-shape: Page through the ways to play the chord you are on
descs.jam-next-section: Jump to the start of the next section at the bar line
descs.jam-prev-section: Jump back to the start of the previous section at the bar line
descs.jam-loop-section: Loop the section you are in, or stop looping it
descs.jam-take: Record the next time you press play, or stop recording
descs.songs-loop-start: Start the portion at the bar you are playing
descs.songs-loop-end: End the portion at the bar you are playing
descs.songs-loop: Play the chosen bars round and round, or stop
descs.songs-loop-clear: Forget the portion and play the piece from the top
descs.songs-loop-earlier: Slide the chosen bars one bar towards the start, keeping their length
descs.songs-loop-later: Slide the chosen bars one bar towards the end, keeping their length
descs.songs-take: Record the next time you press play, or stop recording
descs.songs-camera: Film the next time you press play, or turn the camera off
descs.jam-camera: Film the next time you press play, or turn the camera off
descs.session-go: In a Session: start the Take, stop it, or do whatever the big button says
descs.session-next: Between Takes: move on to the next thing in the Session
descs.session-pedal: For a single footswitch. Tap: the next thing (pauses a running warm-up). Double tap: slower. Hold: again
descs.session-exit: In a Session: leave it, as Exit does. A running Take stops first.
descs.session-view: In a Session: Neck, Runway or Tab. Any time in a warm-up; between Takes in a graded one
descs.session-pause: In a warm-up or a timed block: pause it, or carry on
descs.session-restart: In a warm-up or a timed block: from the top. After a Take: the same Take again
descs.session-prev: In a Session: back to the block before this one
descs.session-watch: Before a Take, on the neck: light the notes in order at the tempo, or stop. No sound, nothing graded

coachDownload.studioDesc: Best quality, most nuanced feedback, strongest Q&A. Handles complex patterns, fast tempos, and polyrhythms.
coachDownload.stdDesc: Good comments, solid Q&A, reliable timing decisions. Best for simple time signatures and moderate tempos.
